newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fr Telecom share sale price set end-May - minister.
newsitem.headline: Fr Telecom share sale price set end-May - minister.

text.p: The French government will publish a price range for the opening of France Telecom's share capital at the start of May and set the sale price towards the end of the month, according to telecoms minister Francois Fillon.

"The government will communicate a price range at the start of May and open reservations to both private individuals and institutional investors," Fillon said in an interview to be published in Les Echos newspaper on Thursday.
"In the last days of May, following the opinion of the Privatisation Commission, the government will set the price of the shares and proceed with the public sale offer," he said.
An advance copy of the interview was supplied to Reuters.
The government is partially privatising the world's fourth largest telecoms operator, with a 20-25 percent stake sale in the first stage.
A France Telecom spokesman said on Wednesday the May share flotation would be "for at least 25 billion francs."
